parole.testo: Borrowed from Hindustani حقہ / हुक़्क़ा (huqqā) and, in turn, derived from Arabic حُقَّة (ḥuqqa, “pot, jar”), from حُقّ (ḥuqq, “cavity, hollow”).
From Hindustani عیسائی/ईसाई (īsāī, “people of Jesus”), from Arabic عِيسَى (ʕīsā, “Jesus”).

parole.significato: An individual installment of the yearly land revenue.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Hindustani قِسْط (qisṭ, “installment”) / क़िस्त (qist), from Arabic قِسْط (qisṭ, literally “quota”).

parole.significato: A pair of tuned hand drums, used in various musical genres of the Indian subcontinent, that are similar to bongos.
parole.testo: From Hindustani طبلہ / तबला (tablā), from Arabic طَبْلَة (ṭabla). Cognate of Catalan, Spanish, Portuguese tambor.
